override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Pascal (pascal, RL/Iron/Supporter/Burst I, cd 40s) is a pure sustain kit — no ATK, crit, damage-taken, weapon-state or gauge line anywhere in the three slots, so she deals and enables ZERO direct damage in the sim. S1 heals 1 ally for 6.28% of Pascal's final Max HP every 10 rounds fired (recurring, not once-per-battle); the burst heals 3 allies for 55.29% on cast. Heals are offensively inert at scope lock (immortal boss, no HP pool), so these blocks exist for exactly one reason: they emit heal events that fire teammates' 'recovery' triggers (crown-style "when recovery takes effect") — the tandem/cross-unit rule forbids skipping them on isolation. ⚑ "highest final DEF" is a stand-in target (see caveats) because no DEF-ranked TargetDef exists; the count-1 cardinality is faithful, the identity is not. S2 is fully unmodeled: "Incoming healing ▲ 38.4%" has no StatKey, and it only scales heal MAGNITUDE, which nothing in v1 consumes (recovery triggers fire on application regardless of amount) — so the omission is magnitude-only, not a lost trigger. Her burst is a Burst I with no damage component, so no noFb / noRange / core question arises anywhere in this kit.
